syllabus_topics: Individual project solving problem from the automatic control realm, its' documentation, publication or presentation in the range of the next variants of this project.
Project specialized for advanced technological means of automatic control of computer modeling.
Analysis of the problem, design the structure of control system, design of the HW, SW part of the proposal, the visualization on a PC or operator panels.
Database project in the MS Access environment using SQL and the Visual Basics (for another means, consult lecturer).
Project debugging, documentation, presentation using presentation software and creation of a web page or poster about the project.
Design of the application, application preparing, programming, debugging and testing.
Presentation of tested application, poster and eventually web-site creation.
assessment_rules: Typically elaborate a report and defend it.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
